⦁ Canal View
⦁ Open View

Project Features :

DAMAC Business Tower is a commercial building in Business Bay offering modern office and retail spaces with high-speed internet, meeting rooms, and professional amenities. With its prime location near Sheikh Zayed Road and Downtown Dubai, it’s ideal for businesses seeking a central, well-connected workspace.

About the Community :

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s leading commercial hubs, strategically located between Downtown Dubai and Sheikh Zayed Road. Designed as a central business district, it offers a mix of high-rise offices, luxury hotels, and residential towers. With excellent transport links, including metro access and proximity to Dubai’s major highways, it’s ideal for companies seeking a prestigious address,  and close proximity to financial, retail, and lifestyle centers. Business Bay combines convenience, connectivity, and a professional environment — making it a top choice for local and international businesses.
